Pianist Joe Bushkin was born in New York City on November 7, 1916. He started performing professionally in 1932 with Frank LaMarr at the Roseland Ballroom and since then has played with virtually all the great jazz stars including Louis Armstrong, Eddie Condon and Billie Holiday. Joe is known mostly for his distinctive piano work but also made a mark as a trumpeter and songwriter. His wealth of knowledge about jazz is legendary and he has been a guest on Marian McPartland’s “Piano Jazz” series.
Joe was interviewed in Los Angeles on February 15, 1999, by Monk Rowe, director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
